sampling: Same sampled posedge of clk, after reset release

rules.rule: For i in 0..2, src == i implies arready[i] == 1, including arvalid == 0 cycles.
rules.idle: src == 3 is allowed only with arvalid == 0. When arready == 0, use src == 3 and arvalid == 0.
rules.supersedes: Selected-source rejection with a different ready lane was legal under the previous input contract.

rules.rule: For i in 0..2, rready[i] == 0 implies rvalid[i] == 0.
rules.implementation: The existing R arbitration selects only completed source heads with rready[i] == 1.

rules.rule: For i in 0..7, req[i] == 0 implies ar_rd_gnt[i] == 0.
rules.issue_success: req[i], ar_rd_gnt[i], and rw_rd_gnt[i] must all be 1. A requested bank may be denied a grant.
